name: retrospective
description: Optional end-of-delivery retrospective stage. Lane 1 (primary): co-author durable, customer-owned code documentation (ADR, codebase orientation, known-limitations register, code lessons). Lane 2 (secondary): harvest AI-DLC process learnings from the stage diaries and promote kept candidates through the deterministic learnings path. Opt-in: ships its own scope, so a team turns it on and nobody else meets a new gate at the end of Operation.
